title: Rollcall owners file
description: The input behind ROLLCALL_OWNERS_FILE: who answers for which apps, and who asked for a digest. Rollcall keeps its own for the stack's projects in the repo (owners.json), naming roles and team aliases only, because the repo is public; a deployer scanning another fleet keeps theirs wherever they keep the snapshots. An owner without "digest": true gets nothing, and a scanned app no entry lists is reported as "no owner on file".

$schema.description: Optional: the path or URL of this schema, so an editor can check the file as you type. Rollcall ignores it

contact.description: A mail address (required to send), a team alias or a role; each contact once. In a public repo, a team or a role, never a person

digest.description: Opt in to the digest. Left out means no

confirmed.description: The day (YYYY-MM-DD) this contact last confirmed it still answers for these projects. Left out means never confirmed: `rollcall owners` calls the owner unknown once the date is older than ROLLCALL_OWNERS_CONFIRM_DAYS (365 by default)

projects.description: The group/project paths this contact answers for, as the scan names them. An app may be listed under more than one contact
